user.title: Entity Configuration
user.description: Select the Home Assistant entities to use for power prediction. All three entities must have long-term statistics enabled in the recorder.

data_description.power_entity: The sensor tracking your total power consumption (e.g. sensor.power_consumption). Must have long-term statistics.
data_description.temperature_entity: An outdoor temperature sensor (e.g. sensor.outdoor_temperature). Must have long-term statistics.
data_description.weather_forecast_entity: A weather entity that provides an hourly forecast (e.g. weather.home).

model.title: Model Parameters
model.description: Configure the prediction model. The defaults work well for most setups.

data.use_dynamic_quantile: Use Dynamic Quantile (different peak / off-peak levels)
data.quantile: Quantile (used when dynamic quantile is off)

data_description.min_power: Clamp predicted values to at least this value in kW (0 = no minimum beyond zero).
data_description.max_power: Clamp predicted values to at most this value in kW. Set to your circuit breaker or inverter capacity.
data_description.history_days: How many days of historical data to train on (1–365).
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often to retrain and refresh predictions. Minimum 15 minutes.
data_description.n_power_lags: Number of previous hourly power readings to include as features (0 = none).
data_description.n_temp_lags: Number of previous hourly temperature readings to include as features (0 = none).
data_description.use_dynamic_quantile: When enabled, a higher quantile is used during peak hours and a lower quantile off-peak, giving more conservative estimates when consumption is typically highest.
data_description.quantile: The quantile to predict (0.5 = median, 0.75 = 75th percentile). Only used when dynamic quantile is off.
data_description.peak_start: Hour of day when the peak period begins (inclusive).
data_description.peak_end: Hour of day when the peak period ends (inclusive).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to Home Assistant recorder.
